voiceScript: Your antivirus might be missing the behavior that gives an attack away. Endpoint Protection means software that watches laptops, desktops, and other devices for malicious behavior and can isolate threats before they spread. Picture this: an employee opens a fake invoice and the laptop starts making unusual network connections. Here is why that matters: one infected device can expose passwords, files, and the company network. Install endpoint protection on every work device. Keep it updated and investigate its alerts.
